fields.name: patentId
fields.description: Patent ID. Only a single value is supported; multiple values separated by commas are not allowed. When both patentNumber and this are present, the patent ID takes precedence. Max length: 60000 characters

fields.name: patentNumber
fields.description: Publication (announcement) number. Only a single value is supported; multiple values separated by commas are not allowed. Max length: 60000 characters

fields.name: lang
fields.description: Translation language. Supports en (English, default), cn (Chinese), jp (Japanese). Max length: 1000 characters

fields.name: replaceByRelated
fields.description: Whether to substitute with a family patent when claims are unavailable: 1 yes, 0 no (default)
